parts.name: cat
sources: Quaternius, Animal Pack Vol.2 (2017): Dog.fbx. https://opengameart.org/content/animated-animales-low-poly CC0 1.0 (public domain): https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
A cat of Việt Nam (mèo ta): a small short-haired cat, about 25 cm at the shoulder, gray with a white chest and white paws, a long tail up.
A domestic cat: about 23 to 25 cm at the shoulder, about 46 cm long without the tail, a tail of 25 to 30 cm, 3.5 to 4.5 kg. The numbers of the shape are a guess from these sizes and from photos.
